name: Predecessor
source:
Dean of the Dōjō and [url=/c23426]Amane[/url]'s grandfather.

Although he is too old to give judo lessons himself, he attends classes so that he can ensure that the rules are not violated. He also serves as a judge when there is a conflict between the [url=/c78512]mentor[/url] and the apprentices.

Just as traditional as his son, he is however more tender with the students even if he knows how to be authoritarian and severe.

[spoiler]In Amane's route, [url=/c28843]Shuuji[/url] confided to him some embarrassing things about the evolution of his relationship with Amane. In response, the dean (happy and smiling) asks Shuuji to take good care of his granddaughter.[/spoiler]
